rule: Submitted via GitLab Merge Request or wine-devel@winehq.org mailing list

rule: C code style follows Linux kernel style with 8-character tabs
notes: K&R style with 8-character tabs for indentation

rule: Line length limit set to 96 characters in checkpatch configuration
notes: Relaxed from 80 to 96 columns via --max-line-length=96 in .checkpatch.conf

rule: Style checks executed via util/lint/check-style before submitting
notes: Runs checkpatch and custom lint rules on staged git changes

rule: Commit summary must have subsystem prefix, max 65 chars
notes: Format: <subsystem>: <imperative summary>

rule: Commit message body wrapped at 72 characters
notes: Explains rationale and hardware context

rule: Mandatory Change-Id trailer generated by Gerrit commit-msg hook
notes: Required for patch tracking in Gerrit code review

rule: Signed-off-by trailer required under Developer Certificate of Origin
notes: Certifies contributor rights under DCO

rule: SPDX-License-Identifier required in all new source files
notes: Verified by automated lint check in CI

rule: Code submitted to coreboot Gerrit review server; requires +2 Code-Review and +1 Verified
notes: Independent maintainer reviews required before merge

rule: Changes must compile across boards without regressions using util/abuild/abuild
notes: abuild compiles payload and board targets across architectures

rule: GPL-2.0-only or GPL-2.0-or-later licensing required
notes: Standard copyleft licensing for coreboot firmware

rule: C++ formatted using clang-format version 20+ with repository .clang-format
notes: Enforces 4-space indents, brace placement, and whitespace rules

rule: Custom code style rules enforced by Meta/check-style.py
notes: Checks include guards, copyright, and Serenity-specific idioms

rule: Naming conventions: CamelCase for types, snake_case for functions/vars, SCREAMING_CASE for constants
notes: Consistent naming enforced across kernel and userland libraries

rule: Member variables must have prefixes: m_ for instance, s_ for static, g_ for global
notes: Data members in classes must be private

rule: Manual memory management (new/delete) prohibited; use AK smart pointers
notes: NonnullRefPtr, RefPtr, NonnullOwnPtr, OwnPtr manage ownership

rule: Error handling must use ErrorOr<T> with TRY() macro; C++ exceptions disabled
notes: Compile-time enforcement via -fno-exceptions flag

rule: Runtime Type Information (RTTI) disabled; use AK is<T>() and to<T>() helpers
notes: Compile-time enforcement via -fno-rtti flag

rule: Commit message verified by Meta/lint-commit.sh: <Category>: <Summary>, imperative mood
notes: Summary <= 72 chars; detailed explanation in body

rule: Standard BSD 2-Clause license header required on all source files
notes: SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause verified by check-style

rule: Unit tests in Tests/ and Lagom test runner must pass cleanly
notes: Lagom enables building and testing userland libraries on host Linux/macOS

rule: CI workflow executes linting, clang-format, unit tests, and AddressSanitizer
notes: Presubmit testing on all GitHub pull requests

rule: GitHub PR review; commits must be squashed/rebased into atomic logical units
notes: Linear history preserved; no extraneous merge commits

rule: Indentation using true tabs, formatted to 4 spaces per tab stop
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. True tab characters mandatory for indentation

rule: Line length limit of 100 characters
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Lines wrapped cleanly before 100 characters

rule: Member variables must be prefixed with f (e.g. fMember, fStatus)
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Distinguishes member variables from locals

rule: Static member variables must be prefixed with s (e.g. sGlobalCounter)
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Distinguishes static class variables

rule: Global variables must be prefixed with g (e.g. gApplication)
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Distinguishes global variables

rule: Tabular column alignment inside class declarations for types and identifiers
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Tab stops align qualifiers, types, and names vertically

rule: Function definition opening brace placed on next line at column 0; control blocks on same line
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. K&R style control braces, GNU/BSD style function braces

rule: Commit message must include component prefix and imperative summary
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Format: <component>: <imperative summary>

rule: Gerrit Change-Id trailer required for code review submission
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Generated by standard Gerrit commit-msg hook

rule: Changes submitted to Haiku Gerrit code review server
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Code review at https://review.haiku-os.org/

rule: All new native Haiku code must be licensed under MIT License
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Permissive MIT license covers Haiku API and userland

rule: Test suite in src/tests/ must pass for modified subsystems
notes: Unversioned web guidelines; read 2026-11-03. Jam build system runs automated test targets

rule: 4 space indentation, tabs strictly prohibited
notes: IndentWidth: 4, UseTab: Never based on Microsoft style

rule: Allman brace placement: braces always placed on their own line
notes: BreakBeforeBraces: Allman configured in .clang-format

rule: Function return type placed on its own line preceding function name
notes: AlwaysBreakAfterReturnType: All configured in .clang-format

rule: Space before parentheses in control statements, no space in function calls
notes: SpaceBeforeParens: ControlStatements in .clang-format

rule: Clean-room reverse engineering mandatory: contributors swear they have not seen leaked Windows or WRK source
notes: Legal notice in CONTRIBUTING.md strictly enforced to prevent copyright infringement

rule: Ported Wine tests and ReactOS native apitests (rostests) must pass without regressions
notes: Ensures binary Windows API compatibility

rule: Pull request branch must be cleanly rebased against master without merge commits
notes: Clean atomic commits; rebase before submitting PR

rule: Commit message must describe problem solved and reference JIRA issue ID
notes: Links PR to ReactOS JIRA issue tracking system

rule: Code licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later or LGPL-2.1-or-later; 3rd party code isolated
notes: Third party imports kept in media/doc/3rd Party Files.txt

rule: GitHub Pull Request review requiring approvals from core subsystem developers
notes: Peer review conducted on GitHub PRs
